邀请同事加入联合群: Invite a colleague to the joint group
把邀请码通过微信等发给同事。它只显示在这台电脑上，不会进群消息，也不会发给任何: Send the invite code to your colleague (WeChat or similar). It's shown only on this computer: it doesn't go into the group chat and isn't given to any AI.
复制不了，已经选中，按 ⌘C 复制: Couldn't copy automatically. It's selected; press ⌘C
粘贴同事发来的邀请码（clawchat-join:…）: Paste the invite code from your colleague (clawchat-join:…)
和同事口头核对这个 6 位号码。对方点「同意」后就能进群。: Read this 6-digit code to your colleague out loud. Once they approve, you'll be in the group.
正在等对方确认…: Waiting for the other side to approve…
加入后可以和对方的 AI 一起讨论。第一版所有 AI 只能讨论，不能改文件、不能: Once you join, you can discuss things with the other side's AIs. In this first version every AI can only discuss: no file changes, no commands.
邀请码不对：应该是一串以 clawchat-join: 开头的文字: That doesn't look like an invite code; it should start with clawchat-join:
有人想加入联合群: Someone wants to join the joint group
和对方口头核对这个号码，确认是本人再同意。: Check this code with them out loud and only approve if it's really them.
第一期所有 AI 只能讨论、不能改文件；对方的 AI 在对方电脑上跑，记忆和额度: In this first version every AI can only discuss and can't change files. The other side's AIs run on their computer; their memory and quota stay there.
对方想取一个文件: The other side wants a file
想从你这里取一个文件: wants to take a file from you
这台设备不支持系统认证，不能发私钥类文件: This device doesn't support system authentication, so private-key files can't be sent
缺少认证挑战值，请重新发起: The authentication challenge is missing; start again
没有完成系统认证，文件没有发出去: System authentication wasn't completed; the file wasn't sent
还没有收到文件。对方发来的文件会放在这里，默认不给任何 AI 看。: No files yet. Files from the other side land here and are not shown to any AI by default.
退出以后这个群里就看不到对方的成员和消息了；本地的聊天记录不会被删。: After leaving you won't see the other side's members or messages here. Your local chat history stays.
和同事的 ClawChat 一起讨论: Discuss together with a colleague's ClawChat
第一期：所有 AI 只能讨论，不能改文件、不能跑命令: Phase 1: every AI can only discuss; no file changes, no commands
第二期开放，按 AI 分别验收: Opens in phase 2, engine by engine
对方的 AI 看不到你的私聊、别的群和本机文件；停止按钮各管各的。: The other side's AIs can't see your private chats, other groups, or local files. Stop buttons only affect your own side.
邀请同事后，这个群会变成联合群：对方的 AI 在对方电脑上跑，第一期只能讨论、不: After you invite a colleague this group becomes a joint group. Their AIs run on their computer; in this first version they can only discuss and can't change files.
先给联合群起个名字: Give the joint group a name first
至少选一位自己的 AI 进去: Pick at least one of your AIs to join
对方拒绝了这个邀请: The other side declined this invitation
邀请码过期了，请对方重新生成一个: The invite expired; ask them to generate a new one
先填一下你在对方那里的称呼: Fill in what they should call you first
讨论档下，对方 AI 只能读这个文件夹；没验收过读边界的引擎什么文件都不能读。项: In discussion mode the other side's AIs can only read this folder; engines whose read boundary hasn't been verified can't read any files. A project folder and action permissions don't apply to joint groups.
派哪几位 AI 进去: Which of your AIs should join
对方 AI 只能讨论、不能改文件。共享文件夹可以留空。: The other side's AIs can only discuss and can't change files. The shared folder is optional.
可选；留空就什么文件都不给它看: Optional; leave empty to share no files
可选；讨论档里只能读这里: Optional; in discussion mode they can only read this folder
自己这边派谁进去: Which of your AIs are on your side
解散以后对方就进不来了，这个群会恢复成只有你自己成员的普通群；本地的聊天记录不会: After disbanding, the other side can no longer join; this group becomes a normal group with only your own members. Your local chat history stays.
没有建成功，请再试一次: The group wasn't created; please try again
同事怎么称呼你，比如：小李: What should colleagues call you? e.g. Xiao Li
先填一下同事怎么称呼你: Fill in what colleagues should call you
讨论档下，对方 AI 只能讨论、不能读本机文件。项目文件夹、动手权限和共享文件夹: In discussion mode the other side's AIs can only talk and can't read local files. Project folders, action permissions, and shared folders don't apply to joint groups (shared folders come in phase 2).
对方 AI 只能讨论、不能读本机文件。成员名字后面会带上你的称呼，方便两边分清是: The other side's AIs can only talk and can't read local files. Your name is shown after your AIs' names so both sides can tell whose AI is whose.
输入文件名确认发送: Type the file name to confirm
输入上面的文件名: Type the file name shown above
文件名对不上，没有发出去: The file name doesn't match, so it wasn't sent
经 Tailscale 加密传输，文件内容不经过任何 AI，只发这一个文件: Encrypted in transit over Tailscale; file contents never pass through any AI; only this one file
对方想要的文件: The file the other side wants
确认后只发这一个文件: Only this one file will be sent after you confirm
传文件请在电脑上操作: File transfer must be done on the computer
先选择要发送的文件: Choose a file to send first
文件已收到：{name}，在联合群收件箱里: File received: {name}. It's in the joint group inbox
这个联合群里还没有自己这边的 AI。: No AIs on your side in this joint group yet.
这家 AI 还没验收，先只能讨论: This AI hasn't been verified yet, so it can only discuss
对方叫醒它们时，各自能做到哪一步。没验收的引擎先只能讨论。: What each one can do when the other side wakes it. Engines that haven't been verified can only discuss.
对方让我的 AI 动手前，先问我: Ask me before the other side's AI makes mine do something
每次改文件或跑命令都弹确认框；确认之前它什么都不会做。: A confirmation appears before any file change or command; nothing happens until you approve.
只有「指定文件夹」档会动文件；讨论档永远只能看和说。对方看不到你的私聊、别的群和: Only the Selected folder level can change files; Discussion can only read and talk. The other side can't see your private chats, other groups, or anything outside the folder.
权限还没读取出来，请重新打开设置: Permissions haven't loaded; please reopen settings
对方只能在这个文件夹里改文件和跑命令: The other side can only change files and run commands in this folder
这是对方 AI 发来的请求，只有你点「允许这一次」它才开始。停止按钮仍然只停你自: This request came from the other side's AI. It starts only after you click Allow once. Stop buttons still only stop your own AIs.
对方看不到这次操作之外的文件，也不会自动继续下一步；10 分钟不点会自动拒绝。: The other side can't see files outside this operation and won't continue automatically; it will be declined after 10 minutes.
已允许对方动手: Allowed the other side to act
这次动手请求已经结束，只讨论: This action request has ended; discussion only
对方想动手: The other side wants to act
这台电脑用不了 Touch ID 确认: Touch ID isn't available on this computer
把手指放在 Touch ID 上: Put your finger on Touch ID
确认是你本人，才会把这份文件发出去: Confirm it's you before this file is sent
没有完成 Touch ID 确认，文件没有发出去: Touch ID confirmation wasn't completed, so the file wasn't sent
向对方要文件…: Ask the other side for a file…
向对方要一个文件: Ask the other side for a file
对方收到后会先问它那边老板，同意后才把文件发过来。文件内容不经过任何 AI。: The other side will ask their boss first; the file is sent only after they agree. File contents never pass through any AI.
用途（对方会看到）: Purpose (the other side will see this)
比如：部署到测试服务器，麻烦发我一份: e.g. For the test server, please send me a copy
已经向对方发出文件请求: File request sent to the other side
这台电脑的 Touch ID 已登记，之后发私钥类文件需要按指纹: Touch ID is now registered on this computer. Sending private-key files will require your fingerprint.
